versus.openTitle: Compare teams, vehicles, players or any groups you define, in the whole map or in volumes, over the time window and filters
versus.title: Compare groups
versus.combinedTitle: The volumes as one region: a row inside several counts once
versus.separateTitle: Every volume on its own, compared with each other
versus.scopeHint: Always within the time window, the filters and the groups shown.
versus.refTitle: The reference: differences are taken from this group
versus.sourceTitle: Only the rows of these files or matches
versus.topTitle: Show this many; the rest are added up as Other
versus.imported: {n, plural, one {# statistic imported} other {# statistics imported}}
versus.unitTitle: %, s, count, ratio or any word (per match, HP...)
versus.helpText: Aggregates: count(), countIf(condition), sum(x), sumIf(x, condition), avg(x), min(x), max(x), median(x), percentile(x, 90), stdev(x), distinct(column), presence() (seconds), players(), matches(), rounds(), kills(), deaths(), winRate(). Rates: perMinute(v), perMatch(v), perRound(v), perPlayer(v), ofAll(v) (share of the All row), shrink(a, b, 4) (a / b pulled toward the whole place where it rests on little). Arithmetic + - * / between aggregates; conditions with == != < > and or not in; text in quotes. 'where' filters every aggregate: avg(speed) where alt > 1000.
versus.dimHint: A second dimension for lines, areas, histograms and the heat table.
versus.cannotFilter: This group cannot be shown as view filters (its filter is more than column values).
versus.filtered: The view shows {name}. Click again to undo.
versus.pinnedNote: Pinned: load another dataset and tick it under Pinned results to compare.
versus.diffMapTitle: Show the first two groups against each other as a difference heat map
versus.diffMapNo: Needs two groups that each pick values of the same column
versus.pinTitle: Keep this table in this browser, to compare with another dataset
versus.overflow: Many values: the rarest were counted as Other
versus.clickFilter: Click to show only this in the view
versus.fewTitle: Small sample: {rows} rows, {clusters} matches or players
versus.approx: Percentiles from a sample of the values
versus.tableHint: Differences are from the reference group; • marks one whose 95% interval excludes zero. Ratios and win rates are pulled toward the whole place where counts are small.
versus.multiplesTitle: Small multiples: the same chart for every group
versus.needDim: Pick what to draw it over under Over.
versus.err.unclosedName: A name in backticks is not closed
versus.err.unclosedString: A text in quotes is not closed
versus.err.notAValue: Compare {column} with a value in quotes
versus.err.noSuchValue: {column} has no value "{value}"; it has for example {examples}
versus.err.stringAlone: The text "{value}" must be compared with a column
versus.err.whereInside: where goes at the end of the whole statistic
versus.err.whereInFilter: A group filter has no where; write the condition itself
versus.err.categoryInMath: {column} is a category; compare it with a value instead of computing with it
versus.err.categoryAlone: {column} is a category; compare it with a value, like {column} == "..."
versus.err.twoCategories: Two categories can only be compared with == or != and must be the same column
versus.err.orderCategory: {column} is a category: < and > need a number on the other side
versus.err.inNumbers: in on a number column takes numbers
versus.err.aggInRow: {fn}() is an aggregate; it cannot stand inside a row condition
versus.err.columnOutside: {name} is per row: put it inside an aggregate, like avg({name}) or countIf(...)
versus.err.percentileP: The percentile must be a number from 0 to 100
versus.err.shrinkM: The weight of shrink() must be a number of 0 or more
versus.err.noAggregate: A statistic needs an aggregate such as count() or sum(x)
versus.needBox: Pick a number column for the box plot.
versus.needBins: Pick a column in ranges under Over: the histogram counts the rows in each range.
versus.radarHint: Each axis is scaled to its largest value.
versus.waterfallHint: Earnings up, costs down, in the order of the ticked statistics.
versus.funnelHint: The ticked statistics in order, each as a share of the first.
motion.label: Animations
motion.title: Animated charts and panels. Auto turns them and visual extras off while the 3D view runs below 30 frames a second, and back on once it is steady.
motion.autoTitle: Off while the frame rate is below 30 fps
motion.reduced: Off: the system asks for reduced motion
